descriptions.w3d_r25a_create_named_userdata_8019e710: Looks up a named interface using Lua argument one and external key, returns zero if absent; otherwise allocates eight-byte userdata, retains the object, copies environment at context +36, assigns metatable, and returns one.
descriptions.w3d_r25a_initialize_actor_80124edc: Calls base initialization, installs the observed dispatch table, constructs an eight-byte member at +100, clears eight observed words and sets +116 to minus one; returns the object.
descriptions.w3d_r25a_release_list_entries_801ad060: Reads a sixteen-byte header before cursor +120, calls the external owner operation with 44, 3 and each four-byte entry, then decrements the cursor by sixteen and invokes the external cleanup with flag two.
